title: Adjudicatory hearing in the matter of complaint of Claudette Joseph relative to the rates and charges for gas sold by Boston Gas Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid

Rescheduled hearing notice issued to be held Tuesday, March 23, 1993 at 10:30 a.m, Saltonstall (91-AD-15).

Letter from Claudette Joseph, in response to letter dated 1/19/93. RE: Requesting a new hearing (91-AD-15).
